design: Systematic L0..12 attention/MLP output swaps at both matched final-query and source-key positions between binding/copy H747 contexts. Run each swap with selected L13H0 raw Q2(final)/K2(source) free or clamped to native. All240 contexts retained, competence separately reported. Actual raw native states captured for exact clamp. Record intended-answer-margin changes, KL, and frozen H742 compact coordinate movement. No fitting. Baseline no-swap/free-or-clamp controls for every context; self-swap controls for each layer/component/mode on one fixed context.
limitations: Full128D selected Q/K node clamp, not rank4-only mediation. Free-minus-clamped is an intervention dependence contrast, includes downstream interactions and is not a unique causal path fraction. Earlier output swap affects other heads and paths. Two positions swapped together. Data reused from H747.
